visualCharacteristics.purpose: weekly flight schedule of a route with outbound / return tabs, frozen at import, the first rows visible and Show more for the rest
traits: bold tabs 'Frankfurt (plane) London' with a 4px deep blue underline moving to the active tab, centred and stacked below 768px
1px grey row separators, every second row #f2f2f2
per row: departure and arrival time and airport with a plane between, 'Operated by' in 12px, right aligned duration and flight number with a grey divider, seven weekdays with a plane or '-'
weekdays wrap below route and flight info up to 992px
italic disclaimer under the rows, centred 'Show more' with a chevron 60px below

contentPattern.structure: No header row. 'Tab | Frankfurt → London' starts a direction; flight rows have 6 cells: Departure (08:00 FRA) | Arrival (08:40 LHR) | Flight (LH900) | Duration (01:40) | Operated by (carrier code or empty) | Days (We, Th, Fr, Sa). Flight rows before the first Tab row form an unnamed tab; rows with fewer than 5 cells are ignored. Optional 2-cell option rows anywhere: Visible rows (default 6), Weekdays, Duration label, Operated by label, Show more label, Show less label, Flight day label, No flight label, Disclaimer, Tabs label (EN / DE defaults = the live texts).

usage.description: 'Flightplan' section of the AirCore route pages (h2#flightplan-section + .fp.flight-table-wrapper).

reuseGuidance: Use for frozen flight schedules with weekday operation per flight. For linked route/price rows use table-deals, for key/value data table-striped. Exports readFlightplan for tests.
